Builds and returns a new ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor instance with the
configured properties.
items.translation: 构建并返回一个新的 ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor 实例，该实例包含已配置的属性。

items.source:
Sets the eviction strategy that determines when session tool indexes are
cleared from the advisor's cache.
items.translation: 设置驱逐策略，该策略决定何时从顾问缓存中清除会话工具索引。

items.source: Sets the ToolIndex to be used for finding tools.
items.translation: 设置用于查找工具的 ToolIndex。

items.source: this Builder instance for method chaining
items.translation: 此构建器实例用于方法链式调用。

items.source: Combine with TtlEvictionStrategy via CompositeEvictionStrategy to also release indexes for sessions that have been idle longer than a fixed duration.
items.translation: 结合TtlEvictionStrategy，通过CompositeEvictionStrategy来释放那些空闲时间超过固定时长的会话的索引。

items.source: This builder extends ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder and adds configuration options specific to tool search functionality.
items.translation: 该构建器扩展了ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder，并添加了针对工具搜索功能的特定配置选项。

items.source: Subclasses must override ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder.newCopy() to return an instance of their own type, and override this method to copy their additional fields into it.
items.translation: 子类必须重写ToolCallingAdvisor.Builder.newCopy()以返回其自身类型的实例，并覆盖此方法将其额外字段复制到该实例中。

items.source: Defaults to new LruEvictionStrategy(1000), which retains indexes for at most 1 000 concurrently active sessions and silently evicts the least-recently-used one when the cap is exceeded. Adjust the cap to match the expected peak concurrency of your deployment — lower values reduce memory pressure, higher values reduce unnecessary re-indexing for services with many parallel conversations.
items.translation: 默认为new LruEvictionStrategy(1000)，最多保留 1 000 个并发活跃会话的索引；当达到上限时，会静默淘汰最近最少使用的索引。请根据部署的预期峰值并发量调整该上限：较低的数值可减少内存压力，较高的数值则能减少具有大量并行对话的服务中不必要的重新索引操作。

items.source:
Sets the maximum number of tool references to return in tool search results.
This is the human/user defined default value used when invoking the tool search
tool.
items.translation:
设置工具搜索结果中返回的最大工具引用数量。  
这是调用工具搜索工具时使用的由用户定义的人为默认值。

items.source:
Sets the key name in the context where the conversation ID is stored. By
default, it is "conversationId", but it can be customized if the conversation
ID is stored under a different key in the context.
items.translation: 设置存储对话 ID 的上下文中的键名。默认值为"conversationId"，但如果对话 ID 存储在上下文中不同的键下，则可以自定义该键名。

items.source: Creates a shallow copy of this builder with all current settings. The copy can be used as a template from which per-call overrides (e.g. conversationHistoryEnabled) are applied without mutating the original.
items.translation: 创建此构建器的浅拷贝，包含所有当前设置。该拷贝可用作模板，在此之上应用每次调用的覆盖（例如 conversationHistoryEnabled），而不会修改原始构建器。
